## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows Conventional Commits
- [ ] `make check` passes (lockfile, formatting, lint, types)
- [ ] `make test` passes and coverage has not regressed
- [ ] Tests cover the new behaviour
- [ ] Public API changes are reflected in the docs and `README.md`
